messages:
mia: Hey team — PR #4821 is queued for the 1.8 cut. Can someone take a quick look? Also need to confirm changelog line and if this needs a backport to v1.7.

sam: On it, pinged for review. I'll try to approve if tests pass. :eyes: 

jordan: What's the cutoff time for the cut? I can review after standup.

mia: Cut is 16:00 PT. We need approvals + changelog by 15:30 to have time for the merge queue.

lucy: Quick glance — looks good. One nit in the proto serializer test, I'll leave a review comment.

raj: CI currently failing in integration: "rate_limit_spec flake" — re-running.

ci-bot: CI rerun started for PR #4821 — job/integ-aws (rerun by raj)

sam: Thanks, raj. If re-run passes, I can approve and add the changelog.

mia: Changelog suggestion (for release notes):
```markdown
- runtime: reduce KV cache eviction frequency to improve throughput for long conversations (#4821)
```

jordan: LGTM for changelog text.

lucy: I left a small comment, but it's non-blocking. :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #4821 — job/integ-aws, job/unit-tests

sam: Approved and added "release:needs-cut" label. 

mia: Thanks. Lucy, can you handle backport to release-1.7 if it's low-risk? Command is:
```bash
git checkout release-1.7 && git cherry-pick -x <commit>
```

lucy: Yep, will do after merge.

raj: One more ask — can we add the changelog short entry to internal release notes doc? I can paste it.

mia: Pasted in #release-notes-docs. Also tagging product: @product to verify wording. :small_blue_diamond: 

sam: Scheduling merge close to 15:45 to avoid queue issues. Will notify when merged. :shipit: 

mia: Awesome — thank you all. If anything blocks, ping here.

lucy: Backport PR opened: #4830 -> release-1.7, needs review from eng-sre. 

sam: Merge complete — PR #4821 is merged and tagged for cut.

deploy-bot: Merge detected: PR #4821 merged to main by sam. Release label: release-candidate

mia: Great, marking as ready for cut. :tada:
